monounsaturate.translation: n. （食用的）单一不饱和油（脂）(或脂肪)(如橄榄油、花生油等)

monounsaturated.definition: s. (of long-chain carbon compounds especially fats) saturated except for one multiple bond

monounsaturated fat.translation: 单不饱和脂肪（橄榄和坚果等中所含脂肪, 不会促进胆固醇的有害增长）

monounsaturates.translation: (monounsaturate 的第三人称 -s形式) n. （食用的）单一不饱和油（脂）(或脂肪)(如橄榄油、花生油等)

monoureid.translation: [医] 一酰脲, 一脲化物
